scientific_integrity: Complete finite face poset and acyclic matching; exactly computed five-by-sixty integer Morse attaching differential with a determinant-one five-by-five minor; exhaustive 216-automorphism signed Lefschetz calculation. A same-model scientific check, not independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact homotopy and rational full-group character only for the third non-matching complex of the canonical Pappus graph. Neither general cubic graphs, other thresholds, nor integral representation-lattice structure is classified. Indexed searches leave nonzero priority risk.
title: Fifty-five three-spheres and two invariant homology classes in the Pappus non-matching complex
